title: Terengganu Marathon 2027 Review: A Second Race in Malaysia's Drawbridge City
meta_description: Terengganu Marathon 2027 review: April 30 at Stadium Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin -- a second, full-distance race in Kuala Terengganu.
dek: Set for 30 April 2027 at Stadium Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin, this full-service marathon joins the Terengganu Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research as a second, distinct race in Kuala Terengganu.
verdict: The Terengganu Marathon is a genuinely separate event from the Terengganu Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch, which starts at the city's landmark drawbridge -- this race instead starts at Stadium Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin, a dedicated sports venue. Four distances (5K to full marathon) give it broader range than the half-marathon-only JomRun event. Having two distinct races in the same East Coast Malaysian city within roughly six months of each other speaks to Kuala Terengganu's growing profile as a running destination.

sections.heading: A Second Race in Kuala Terengganu
paragraphs: The Terengganu Marathon offers four distances -- 5K, 10K, 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon -- at Dataran parking, Stadium Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin, Kuala Terengganu. [1][2] This is a genuinely separate event from the Terengganu Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch, which starts at the city's landmark drawbridge and offers only three distances up to 21.1K. Having two distinct races in the same city within roughly six months speaks to Kuala Terengganu's growing running-event profile.

sections.heading: Starting at a Dedicated Sports Stadium
paragraphs: Stadium Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin is a purpose-built sports venue in Kuala Terengganu, giving this race genuine athletic infrastructure to start from -- distinct from the half marathon's more scenic, landmark-anchored drawbridge start covered elsewhere in this research.

sections.heading: Four Distances for Broader Appeal
paragraphs: Unlike the drawbridge-anchored half marathon, this race's 5K-to-42K spread makes it accessible to a wider range of runners, from families and beginners up to full-marathon competitors. [1]

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Open
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration is not yet open. [1] With the race date still well into 2027, this is likely standard pre-season timing rather than any operational concern.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a full-distance marathon option in Terengganu -- distinct from the scenic, half-marathon-only drawbridge race covered elsewhere in this research -- the Terengganu Marathon on 30 April 2027 is a solid, broader-range pick. Watch official channels for registration to open.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Terengganu Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: No -- they're distinct events. This full marathon starts at Stadium Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin and offers four distances up to 42K, while the Terengganu Half Marathon starts at the city's landmark drawbridge with a maximum 21.1K distance. [1]
